Interface KfeAuditLogRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeAuditLogEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>
@Repository public interface KfeAuditLogRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeAuditLogEntity,Long>
Persistence queries for appending and verifying the ordered financial audit chain.

  • Method Details

    • lockAuditAppender

      @Query(value="SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtext(\'GLOBAL_AUDIT_APPENDER\') )", nativeQuery=true) void lockAuditAppender()
      Acquires a transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock shared by all audit appenders.

      Call within the transaction that reads the chain head and inserts the next event so concurrent writers cannot derive the same predecessor hash.

    • findHashRowsAfterSequence

      @Query("select e.sequenceNumber as sequenceNumber, e.eventHash as eventHash\nfrom KfeAuditLogEntity e\nwhere e.sequenceNumber > :afterSequence\norder by e.sequenceNumber asc\n") List<KfeAuditHashRow> findHashRowsAfterSequence(@Param("afterSequence") Long afterSequence, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Selects only chain sequence and hash values after a checkpoint for efficient verification.
      Parameters:
      afterSequence - exclusive sequence checkpoint; rows with greater values are returned
      pageable - page window bounding the verification batch
      Returns:
      hash projections ordered from oldest to newest after the checkpoint
